newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific files $750 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific files $750 mln shelf.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc filed Monday with the Securites and Exchange Commission to sell up to $750 million medium-term notes.
When combined with a previous registration, Union Pacific will have a total offering of $900 million in debt available for sale, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, Credit Suisse First Boston, Goldman Sachs & Co and Petrie Parkman and Co, the filing said.
The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes including repayment of borrowings, working capital, capital expenditures, stock repurchase programs and acquisitions.
Three business trusts, formed by the parent and known as UPRG Capital Trust 1, UPRG Capital Trust 11 and UPRG Capital Trust 111, will also offer preferred stock from time to time.

Fort Worth, Tx.,-based Union Pacific is an independent energy company and is engaged primarily in the exploration for and the development and production of natural gas, natural gas liquids and crude oil in the U.S. and Canada.
